experiment: overlap-then-legalize AT TRUE DEPTH: the corrected redo of pv34 (uniform squeeze) and pv35 (binding-stack nudge), which were both instrument failures

whatWasWrongWithTheOriginals.fakeIncumbentDepth: pv34/pv35 wrote reportedDepthMm = independentDepthMm = 200.0 into the perturbed warm-start fixture. general_request_benchmark.rs ~316/378 installs independentDepthMm as the incumbent's used_long_axis_depth_mm, and general_relaxed.rs ~2628 derives every epoch target from it (target = incumbent * (1 - shrink)). The separator was therefore handed ~36 mm of headroom above the real layout and relaxed into it; the reported '~179 shelf' measures the fake headroom, not the geometry.
whatWasWrongWithTheOriginals.fakeCliTarget: both drivers also passed 200.0 as the CLI target depth, so nothing in the run was bounded by the parent's own depth.
whatWasWrongWithTheOriginals.wrongFrontierSelector: pv35 ranked 'deepest pieces' by translateLongAxis. That is a post-rotation anchor offset: on the 164.058 record it ranges -25.184 to +175.724 on a layout 164.058 deep. The engine's own frontier ordering is high_frontier_blockers (general_relaxed.rs ~13165), by transformed source max-Y.

correctedSetup.perturbation: squeeze anchored on the layout's true transformed depth floor; nudge selected by true transformed max-Y
correctedSetup.declaredIncumbentDepth: the parent's own depth carried at the mode-26 rung seed convention, parent_depth / (1 - COUPLED_SEPARATOR_CONTRACTION_RATIO) = 164.222216, so the separator's first contraction target lands exactly on 164.058
correctedSetup.clamp: sheet long axis overridden to the parent depth (CLI argument 17 = 164.05799340962). This is exactly the mode-26 rung clamp - GeneralFastSettings::sheet_long_axis_mm is what collision_fits_sheet gates every acceptance on - so the separator provably cannot relax depth-ward. Mode 26 itself refuses a final bound equal to the parent depth, which is why the clamp is applied through the existing CLI parameter to a mode-0 run instead.
correctedSetup.rawPerturbedDepthsAlsoRecorded: each perturbed state's own measured depth is logged for the record and cross-validated against mode 27's parentIndependentDepthMm, which agrees exactly

sweep.description: 35 nudges (k in 1,2,3,4,5,6,8 x d in 0.25,0.5,1,2,3) from the 164.058 parent, each legalized by mode 28 under a 164.058 clamp
sweep.publicationDepths: 164.053 x8, 164.054 x10; every k <= 4 publishes at some d, k >= 5 does not

verdicts.separatorAlone: NEGATIVE, and now honestly so. At a truthful incumbent depth and under a clamp at the parent depth, the mode-0 separator accepts zero contraction targets on all seven states at both seeds - clamped and unclamped alike. The original '~179' figure was an artifact; the corrected figure is 'nothing at all'.
verdicts.uniformSqueeze: NEGATIVE, and the correction sharpens rather than overturns it. An affine depth-axis squeeze of even 0.5% shatters the layout into 8-9 violation components whose largest spans 16-36 pieces. That is above every local-repair limit by design (a residue involving more than an eighth of the layout is a search problem), so no repair tier will touch it. The class is closed for a *measured* reason now.
verdicts.bindingStackNudge: REFUTED. The negative does not survive correction. A local nudge of the true depth frontier plus conflict-targeted re-placement under a clamp at the incumbent produces exact-valid states BELOW the record, repeatably, at 18 of 35 (k,d) settings, and cascades 164.058 -> 164.054 -> 164.053 -> 164.043 -> 164.042. See record-164.042/.
